## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      24 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 jun 2026 - 5 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _lupercaia_, 25 ago 2026, 1/5: "i really loved it first, but then the app started working worse and worse. first, some blocks that i set up started duplicating - meaning you had to unblock it twice. then some blocks started showing up on wrong times - like block that’s scheduled for weekdays on Saturday. Then unblocking the blocks became very easy and short for whatever reason?? My final straw was just now when I received the very same push notification frim them TEN TIMES IN A ROW. It used to be a great app, but it’s broken now."
            2. _S.ley1'_, 4 ago 2026, 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
            3. _Wvoqfent_, 26 jun 2026, 1/5: "After the latest update, the app is very slow and does not block the apps even when rules are active. Please fix it!"
